quality_effect: Pins current HMLR title-plan scale and update semantics so scale does not become false precision.
verified_facts: Large rural title plans may be 1:5000 or 1:10000
Title plan and register must be read together
Current OS mapping at registration can differ from adjoining-title mapping editions
New title plans are vector plans
Older raster and paper title plans can remain
A replacement title plan may be prepared when activity requires updating
Measurements copied from deeds may become unreliable as reference features change
